grocketwhistle89 v1.2 - validation report
Generated: 2026-07-19

Build and API validation:
- Compiler: GCC
- Strict flags: -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2
- Core object compiled successfully
- Static library compiled successfully
- Both WAV demo generators compiled and ran successfully
- API test compiled and passed
- AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer API test passed
- Core object has no undefined external symbols (nm -u returned none)
- Whole-word source/header scan found none of these prohibited tokens:
  malloc, realloc, free, float, double

DSP validation:
- Primary six-band contour EQ is active before reverb
- Secondary six-band finishing EQ is active after reverb
- Preset output differs from both primary-flat and output-flat rendering
- Weapon presets reduce final low bands and raise edge/air bands
- Smoothed pitch/amplitude roughness remains bounded
- Second and third harmonic phases are generated without floating point
- Separate fixed plume-air delay taps produce non-identical left/right output
- Optional three-comb damped reverb produces a non-zero post-release tail
- Reverb can be disabled at runtime
- No generated preview contains full-scale clipped PCM samples

A/B normalized spectral-share check, second RPG-7 section versus the
'electronic-ish' first section:
- 120-300 Hz: approximately 0.49x
- 300-900 Hz: approximately 0.64x
- 2.4-6 kHz: approximately 3.01x
- above 6 kHz: approximately 2.76x
The below-120 Hz share is negligible in both sections; reverb makes that tiny
residual unsuitable as a simple before/after ratio.

Memory and object reference sizes:
- Caller-owned state: 18,296 bytes per voice
- Fixed plume-air delay memory: 512 bytes per voice
- Linux GCC object: text 9,990 bytes, data 1,680 bytes, bss 0 bytes
- Total object reference size: 11,670 bytes

- 44.1 kHz

Research limitation:
Public pyrotechnic and live-fire media pages were available for qualitative
comparison, but their audio tracks were not reliably downloadable in the
validation environment for automated spectral matching. No source recording is
bundled and no claim of sample-accurate reconstruction is made.

Portability note:
A MinGW cross-compiler was not installed in the build container. The package
includes build_mingw.bat and uses C89-compatible source, but the exact Win32
MinGW build was not executed here.
